projects.title: Autonomous Ackermann configuration vehicle for lane tracking through real-time digital image processing
projects.description: This project was developed with the use of the OpenCV library for the digital image processing section and an implementation of a Proportional-Derivative system that adjusted the servomotor turn angle.

projects.title: Robotic Arm Controlled with an EMG Input Controller and Microelectromechanical Sensors
projects.description: This project consists in the extraction and analysis of a physiological signal using ﬁlter concepts and the application of microelectromechanical sensors such as gyroscopes and accelerometers to measure rotational speed and acceleration. Finally, these signals and measurements are combined to control a robotic arm. The implemented system is oriented to industrial applications that require manipulation of materials or machinery that could potentially represent a chemical or physical hazard to the labor force.
